programme.title: Spies in the snow
programme.desc: The creators of the documentary record funny and dramatic situations involving penguins, polar bears and sea otters. To be able to take a closer look at their heroes, they let spies into their ranks - dummy animals with cameras installed. They go to hard-to-reach, snowy Alaska. The first emissary, an artificial otter, is tasked with filming a mother and her newborn children. Despite the cold, otters can give birth even in the middle of winter. The young are protected by a down blanket. A human eye will accompany the family until the ice melts and the baby takes its first steps in independent life. Some of the material was obtained thanks to a camera placed... in an artificial snowball that moves using invisible elements. It is a true technological marvel, equipped with a self-aligning lens. The artificial bald eagle, on the other hand, uses drone technology. Designed to be indistinguishable from living birds, it allows you to observe nature from above... Great Britain. 2018. documentary film

programme.title: Primates – The Secret to Survival | E01
programme.desc: A documentary series devoted to our favorite primates, presenting species that are rarely shown on screen. Modern technology has enabled creators to capture their world from a unique perspective and in their natural environment, whether it is the treetops of a flood forest or the dense bushes shrouded in the darkness of a Sri Lankan night. Over the course of two years, the filmmakers undertook twenty-eight expeditions around the world, braving snowstorms in the Moroccan Atlas Mountains and wading through flooded jungles in remote corners of Sumatra and Brazil. They were among the first in history to immortalize the newly discovered Tapanuli orangutan species and were the first in years to attempt to film a white uakari. One team spent over two months in Equatorial Guinea, camping on a remote beach to record the most intimate scenes from the life of a mandrill, one of the least understood primates in the world. In Sri Lanka, thanks to low-light technology, the first color images of mysterious gray loris in the wild were captured at night. Captivating animal stories combine real family drama with cutting-edge science. A seemingly terrifying silver-backed mountain gorilla encountered on the volcanic slopes of the Congo turns out to be a gentle and caring father to its young. According to the latest research, it is caring fathers who achieve the greatest reproductive success. Viewers will also see South Africa's elusive pygmy galago, part of a recently discovered urban population, as it raids the local zoo at night. In Malaysia, they will learn about the world of treetops from the perspective of white-handed gibbons, shown on screen for the first time in history. The unique series is narrated by naturalist Chris Packham. Among the fog-covered slopes of volcanoes in the Congo Basin live some of the largest and most famous primates. Among them is a silver-backed mountain gorilla that uses a surprising strategy. He bases his domination and power on a bold show of force, thanks to which he maintains order in the family's life. However, when the offspring refuses to respect the father's authority, the dangerous tyrant reveals his gentler face. It turns out that this dangerous leader is more than just an aggressive guardian of the hearth. He can also be gentle and sensitive. Recent research shows that an alpha male must demonstrate more than just strength to be successful. Meanwhile, hard times have come for the herd of bearded capuchin monkeys living in the Brazilian highlands. The sun-baked canyons there haven't seen a drop of rain in eight months. However, monkeys have found a solution to the lack of food and water - they catch lizards, which are a source of protein and water, and also eat wild cashew nuts, which are rich in fats and minerals. In South Africa, nocturnal galagos are also searching for missing food. In Pretoria, under the cover of darkness, they raid the city zoo. While the park's predatory inhabitants sit in cages, the galagos can roam around without fear. Clever animals have learned to navigate zoos with an unusual trick to help them do so - they smear sticky drops of urine on their hands and feet to leave a trail of scent behind them and at the same time give their limbs extra traction for jumping. In India's Western Ghats, lion macaques have abandoned cooperation in favor of a strategy based on the exploitation of other animals. Giant squirrels have an excellent sense of smell adapted to recognize ripe jackfruit, so clever macaques allow them to use it to then steal the prey from the squirrels. Lemurs living in Madagascar constitute one fifth of all primates. This island is also the only place in the world where they can be found. Like many primates, lemurs are attacked by ticks and other parasites. However, we meet a group of blue-eyed lemurs that have developed a brilliant way of dealing with pests - self-medication. USA, Great Britain. 2020. documentary film

programme.title: Big Brother Oasis | E01
programme.desc: A nature series devoted to the world's first artificial waterhole and the animals that use it. It was created in a reserve in Tanzania, an area of ​​the African savannah with poor water resources. It is not only an excellent vantage point for hidden cameras, but also a place of respite for wild animals such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos. Thanks to hidden cameras, scientists want to track the secret behaviors of creatures gathering around the waterhole. They are wondering, among other things: whether half-year changes affect their customs and how predators and their prey coexist on a daily basis. For creatures such as lions, baboons, elephants, giraffes and buffalos, the waterhole is a place of respite. It is a field of observation for scientists. Researchers are wondering how predators and potential prey coexist. Great Britain, USA. 2020. nature series

programme.title: 30 for 30: Winning Time: Reggie Miller vs. The New York Knicks
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

Morgan Freeman examines this hypothesized future and also takes a look back into millennia to find out what the end of the world should be like. His journey takes him into the desert that three religions call home to study the Qumran manuscripts and also learn about the origins of the Jewish Messiah. He will work on deciphering the mysterious mark of the beast "666" in Rome, and will also talk with a former Islamic terrorist. Travel to Guatemala to find out if the Mayans really predicted the end of the world, and talk to a philosopher who will explain why some people find peace in disasters. programme.title: Fletchers' Family Farm at Christmas
programme.desc: Kelvin and Liz Fletcher and their children are preparing a big Christmas event on the farm. Between baby alpacas, pony rescues and Christmas tree searches, the anticipation for the festival is growing. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Lioness Maya complains about a broken tooth. In order to prevent a more serious subsequent illness, the big cat has to go to the dentist. Newcomer Eve receives swimming lessons from the seals. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Chief veterinarian Larry is studying six koala populations in southeast Australia as part of a project. At Taronga Zoo, the zookeepers are happy about the offspring of the pygmy hippos. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: A zookeeper takes on the role of mother for the abandoned koala cub Gracie. Veterinarian Sarah performs an operation on Miguel the basilisk lizard to save his eyesight. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Zookeeper Jacob learns how his colleagues ensure that the zoo's savannah animals live together peacefully. The check-up of two kangaroos becomes a challenge. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: A platypus is brought to Taronga Zoo completely emaciated. Will the team manage to nurture the little mammal again? Meanwhile, cheetah Liberty has to go for an ovulation test. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Health checks, including general anesthesia, are scheduled for a total of 21 chimpanzees. A mammoth task for the veterinary team, not least because a mother and baby have to be examined. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Taronga Zoo's chimpanzees are due for health check-ups. Three of the monkeys have a family history of heart attacks. Does the cardiologist find any evidence of an illness? (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Nele's eyes have clouded over. The zookeeper is concerned and orders an examination. But treating a hippopotamus like this is a challenge even for the experienced Taronga team. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: The team nurtures an underweight penguin before returning it to its natural habitat. And the security team needs to find a gap in the fence around Taronga. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: At Taronga's Western Plains Zoo, seven Asian elephants are looking forward to a long swim. Because a marsupial causes trouble when it comes to feeding, a laser-controlled machine is purchased. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Tensions in the gorilla enclosure, a complicated return transport for the sea lions and new play equipment for the elephants: Taronga Zoo is facing emotional and logistical challenges. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: The Sumatran tigers Sartu and Sakti are being medically examined. Capybara Carlos receives his first vaccination. Animal keeper Laura is looking for 10,000 termites as food for the echidnas. (Station info).

programme.title: TỰ LỰC CÁNH SINH - SELF RELIANCE
programme.desc: Có cơ hội tham gia vào một chương trình trò chơi thực tế sống hoặc tử vong, một người đàn ông phát hiện ra có rất nhiều điều để sống.

programme.title: LƠ LỬNG GIỮA KHÔNG TRUNG - UP IN THE AIR
programme.desc: George Clooney là Ryan Bingham, một chuyên gia thu hẹp quy mô của công ty có cuộc sống trân trọng trên đường bị đe dọa.

programme.title: TRẬN ĐẤU PHỤC HẬN - GRUDGE MATCH
programme.desc: Ba mươi năm sau trận tranh đai cuối cùng, hai võ sĩ đã nghỉ hưu và đối thủ lâu năm quyết định bước lên võ đài một lần nữa để giải quyết mối thù cũ.

programme.title: CÔNG VIÊN KỈ JURA - JURASSIC PARK
programme.desc: Kiệt tác của Steven Spielberg theo sau một nhóm các nhà khoa học trên một hòn đảo để chứng kiến ​​những con khủng long thực sự trong một công viên, chỉ để thấy mọi thứ đi sai khi một cơn bão ập đến.

programme.title: THẾ GIỚI ĐÃ MẤT: CÔNG VIÊN KỈ JURA - THE LOST WORLD: JURASSIC PARK
programme.desc: Bốn năm sau Công viên kỷ Jura, nhà toán học Ian Malcolm phải dấn thân vào hòn đảo thứ hai để cứu bạn gái mình khỏi trở thành mồi ngon cho khủng long.

programme.title: BỐN GIÁNG SINH - FOUR CHRISTMASES
programme.desc: Khi chuyến bay kỳ nghỉ kỳ lạ của họ bị hủy, một cặp vợ chồng không còn lựa chọn nào khác ngoài việc đón Giáng sinh với cha mẹ đã ly hôn và những gia đình rối loạn chức năng.

programme.title: CHIẾC LA BÀN VÀNG - THE GOLDEN COMPASS
programme.desc: Một cô gái phải sử dụng la bàn ma thuật của mình để tìm kiếm những đứa trẻ bị bắt cóc trong một âm mưu có thể gây nguy hiểm cho thế giới.

programme.title: SẢN PHẨM CỦA MỸ - AMERICAN MADE
programme.desc: Tom Cruise đóng vai chính trong một cuộc phiêu lưu quốc tế dựa trên những chiến công thực sự, táo bạo của người hối hả và phi công được tuyển dụng để điều hành một trong những hoạt động bí mật lớn nhất ở Hoa Kỳ.

programme.title: HẢI VƯƠNG - AQUAMAN
programme.desc: Một người đàn ông nửa người, nửa người Atlantean đi trên một hành trình để xem liệu anh ta có phải là vị vua chính đáng của Atlantis hay không.

programme.title: DU HÀNH GIỮA CÁC VÌ SAO: PHÂN ĐỘI 31 - STAR TREK: SECTION 31
programme.desc: Hoàng đế Philippa Georgiou tham gia một bộ phận bí mật của Starfleet, được giao nhiệm vụ bảo vệ Liên đoàn hành tinh thống nhất.

programme.title: MỘT GÓC CORNWALL CỦA RICK STEIN - RICK STEIN'S CORNWALL
